nom: TONYMOLY I'm Charcoal All Over Blemish Patch

avis.texte: these are the WORST! I've tried many different patches and all these did we dry out my skin . nothing else. do not recommend.
When i took it off, it had made my skin awful and bumby 1/10 do not try this

I bought these in store a couple of days ago, not expecting much, but i have super hard water, and my pores have been literally the worst tbey have EVER been im my 26 years of life. I washed my face like the instructions said, i toned, and then put the patch on for like 9-10 hours. I cooked and did stuff around the hiuse snd did get a bit sweaty. After i removed the patch, i washed my face with la rouche posay face wash with salicylic acid, and toned, and i cannot express how dramatically this changed my pores. I mean i was genuinely shook. My partner noticed the difference too and he was shook as well. I cannot recommend this enough.

skip these patches. I love Tonymoly and was really looking forward to using them and was left really disappointed. they were hard to apply and mildly uncomfortable, enough to the point I couldn't sleep well even though they're recommended to wear at night. and they didn't do a whole lot, it did not remove black heads or any other pimples I had, it did draw the puss closer to the surface of the skin making it easier go remove but personally if I'm using a patch I don't always want to have to squeeze on my skin. I wouldn't purchase again and suggest passing on this product.

This product does nothing but rip out any peach fuzz you have. It claims to help with oil & pulling blemishes to the surface but I noticed no difference after using. Atleast with the typical clear hydrocolloid patches you can see on the patch that something happened. Dont waste your $ on these

I have easily irritated skin, and unfortunately this was very rough coming off in the morning. More of a ripping than a gentle peel that left my skin very red. I also didn't notice any affect on my blemishes like other pimple patch products have helped, sadly.

Finding that im never disappointed with Tony Moly products! Bought these on line thinking they were like those pore strips that you wet & let dry & pull off. These are SO much better than that! Must be worn over night. My nose has always had slightly larger pores with small blackheads you can see in mag mirror. Used the nose and chin strips last night. Next time, will make sure to smooth them out more on my nose. At first, was wanting to pull them off! Got used to them quickly. Strips are hydrocolloided, they stick really well, but gently. Looked kind of funny on chin--wrinkled up:) cant believe, when i pulled off my nose, All of the pores are smoothed out and gunk gone--zero tiny blackheads!! I have never seen my nose look like smooth, clean normal skin since i was a kid! It is amazing!! Zero irritation, no redness. No sticky residue. The skin was a bit wrinkled from wearing patch, but that went away pretty quick. This worked so well, i wanted to share the results right away!!! Curious to know how long it lasts/how offen will need to use. Im Stocking up on these right now!!

I absolutely love these acne patches by toly moly! They are so cute and so not leave a sticky residue like most patches do. They are so easy to apply and work so well! I highly recommend! Gifted by toly moly

These are hydrocolloid patches – but their shapes and the cuts on them make them fit perfectly over the contour of the face (such as nose, chin or forehead). I personally found them to be very easy to use. They stick onto the skin very well so you don't have to worry about them falling out during sleep. They feel pretty comfortable on the skin and are effective in drawing out the impurities in the pores. (Gifted by TonyMoly for my honest reviews).

avis.titre: Great results after only one night
avis.texte: I've always had problematic skin and I'm constantly looking for new solutions. This product definitely calms down the irritation, even after one usage and I did not like the idea of sleeping with it, but I guess it is worth it;) full disclosure: I received this product gifted by TONYMOLY.

This product was amazing! I woke up and I noticed a difference in the appearance of my face. It looked and felt so much more smooth than it normally is. I would totally purchase this when I find it! Complimentary from TONYMOLY

This product was amazing! I woke up and I noticed a difference in the appearance of my face. It looked and felt so much more smooth than it normally is. I would totally purchase this when I find it! Complimentary from TONYMOLY

I received this complimentary from TONYMOLY. these face patches work so well. I can tell a huge difference in my skin after one use. My face is so much more smooth, and my pores are unclogged. The face patch is very comfortable to sleep in as well. I'm very happy with these face patches.

Gifted by tonymoly. I am obsessed with these all over blemish patches!!!! I used them overnight and they took a lot out of my pores… it was shocking! But 10/10 recommend. They really make your skin look so good after using!

Not that great. I stuck these all over my fave before going to bed on a clean dry skincare free face and there was nothing on it the next morning. I don't these actually work. Also charcoal is just bad. complimentary from tonymoly

I've been LOVING pimple patches lately so I was so excited to receive the I'm Charcoal All Over Blemish Patches complimentary from TONYMOLY. I applied them just before bed after washing my face and left them on while sleeping. When I woke up and peeled them off, I was shocked to see how much oil and gunk they had unclogged from my pores. I love the charcoal for removing dirt and impurities from my skin and the niacinamide for brightening. These blemish patches really leave your skin fresh and glowy. A new must-have for sure!

avis.titre: Tony Moly all over blemish patch
avis.texte: I really loved these. They do exactly as they say. Great for bringing stubborn blemishes to the surface, and controlling oil. This has charcoal and niacinamide. These are absolutely wonderful!!

Starting off by simply stating this is a new holy grail staple for me. It works so well! I've used this at night before bed and have seen tremendous results come morning. This is perfect for me seeing as I'm a stress ball with all of the constant studying— bye bye zits:) It was gifted by Tonymoly

Gifted by tony moly! these work so WELL!!! I love these. I slept with these on overnight and I woke up to my skin looking super smooth. It took a lot of oil(etc?) out of my pores… and just made my skin look so much better! I love it

This patches really do what they claim! My skin feels clean and pores are unclogged with just one time use of the patches, the only con I can think about is that my forehead got wrinkles after leaving the patch all night but they went away quick, I'm definitely rebuying and his and I recommend it gifted by tony moly

I was gifted by Tonymoly to try and give my honest feedback. I'm really impressed with the results. I love the idea that is an overnight product very easy to apply and very comfortable to wear. Great ingredients niacinamide and charcoal which are great for my type of skin. It really clean clogged pores and smooth the skin. Love it

I was hesitant about sleeping in these patches in fear my skin would dry it but it looks even better after one use ! It was comfortable to sleep in and did it's job without little effort on my end ! Love it

Complimentary from TONYMOLY I love the fact that these are made with charcoal, which is a Natural cleansing ingredient, and niacinamide that will help with the redness of blemishes. This product is really great for people with oily t zones.. It removed a lot of gross stuff I did not suspect is on those zones. I see results and it works great for my skin

This is the ultimate treat! I love that there's a hardworking patch for every single area. These pack a punch without drying me out. It's also helped clear up my skin and has made it substantially brighter! I was sent this products complimentary from TONYMOLY

I was gifted by TONYMOLY and tried out this product and I love it. I like that it is an overnight product so you don't have to worry about wearing it in public or on your face while doing things but you can sleep in it. It's very comfortable to wear and I feel my skin is better now.

I'm charcoal all over blemish patches was gifted by TONYMOLY, Banish blemishes while you sleep with this targeted treatment! Each set includes 5 hydrocolloid patches designed to perfectly fit the forehead, cheeks, chin, and nose. It's not work well on me , when I place them on the face, just 20 mins the patches are non-stick any more. I have to remove them. Maybe my face too oily.

As someone who regularly suffers from adult acne, I was hoping for more from this pricey solution. Because it's only one use, it's difficult to justify the price tag. I left the patches overnight and while I did see a slight reduction in acne, the effect was somewhat diminished by the difficulty in removing the patches and the irritation to the skin the removal caused. Gifted by Tony Moly.

I received these "I'm Charcoal All Over Blemish Patches" to try out and review complimentary from Tonymoly in exchange for my honest opinion. So far, I think that these acne/blemish patches seem okay and easy enough to use, though I haven't seen too much of a difference yet for me with my blackheads, pores, and blemishes.

Gifted by TONYMOLY. This product is really great for people with oily t zones! For me I can get really shiny on my forehead, so I like that these patches are big enough to where they can stick on and draw out any imperfections.

Gifted by TonyMoly! I love these targeted patches for when my skin is needed a little bit of extra TLC. Great sizes and super effective! I will definitely be repurchasing these in the future! Highly recommend!

Definitely a great product to have in your cabinet. I used it on my forehead, overnight and I was pleasantly surprised to learn how well it worked. Even using it overnight, it didn't irritate my skin, it just lifted and cleared some much needed clearing of my blackheads. Would recommend. Gifted by TonyMoly

Great patches! I left them overnight and by the morning it was pretty stuck, so removing might be a bit painful for some, I loved it though. It removed a lot of gross stuff I did not suspect is on those zones. Great product. P.S. complimentary from tonymoly

I really wanted to like this but I really didn't. It was hard to apply smoothly onto my skin and it didn't even stick to the side of my nostrils (where I have the most pores) because of the plastic packaging. Maybe I applied it wrong and was supposed to off the plastic first? It's uncomfortable that I have to keep it on for 8 hours and sleep with it on and the morning after it left some prints on my face where the creases were. My face was slightly smoother but I don't think it really did anything for my pores. It's also pretty expensive because there's only one patch for each area. This was gifted by tonymoly but all thoughts are my own.

avis.titre: Good product but uncomfy to remove!
avis.texte: I received this product gifted by TONYMOLY and tried it out following the instructions on the package and wore the strips overnight. I don't know if I noticed a huge difference but they did somewhat hurt to remove on the areas of my face with more peach fuzz. I think they would be nice to use once in a while but I didn't notice anything spectacular

I apply this patches on dry skin after cleansing before bedtime . I see results and it works great for my skin . Definitely going to repurchase this to use regularly. This product was gifted to me for this review .

I was gifted by tonymoly and i must say As someone who suffers from acne. These patches are a lifesaver. They prevent me from picking at my blemishes and also of course keeps bacteria from getting in. Its a must have

I received these gifted by TONYMOLY in exchange for my honest review. I struggle with acne and these are a great way to target large areas of your face. I break out in clusters so these are great for targeting those areas.

These have seriously changed the game in my face i definitely notice a big difference after using them. You can see the change after one use and it doesn't leave sticky residue or anything! im so obsessed gifted by TONYMOLY

Love these patches! They are large and stick to the skin so well! I actually leave them on overnight so they can work their magic while I sleep. The skin looks so smooth and glowy afterwards, and I also noticed a lot less redness. They also help smooth out the breakouts and the spots seem to heal faster too. I'll be repurchasing these for sure! gifted by tonymoly

I think I would have had a better experience if I used it overnight. I had put them on without realizing it was meant for overnight. But I was able to wear them for at least four hours. I ended up eating and talking with them on and then they ended up stretching and wrinkling up on my face. They still stuck on, but it didn't feel very comfortable. After I remove them, I didn't notice much they came off on them, but it did have all of the pus from my pimples. The next day, my pimples were still red but had no more pus so they're healing faster. Overall, I recommend you wear them overnight for the full affect. They will remove excess oils and pus so it's best to wear them when you have active whiteheads and inflamed acne. Gifted by TONYMOLY

To be honest, using this product did not result in noticeable effects, except to make my skin a little red and irritated. I typically do not have acne but this promised to bring things to the surface of the skin and nothing appeared. Also, if that is how the product works, wouldn't it make the person look like they have MORE acne? Gifted by Tony Moly in exchange for my review.

I love these patches for my face so much. They went on so smoothly and stayed on. They definitely absorb some of the oil from my pores. It made my face feel cleaner in the morning. I don't think the fragrances necessary, but I sent isn't overpowering I was gifted by TONYMOLY and skeepers

avis.titre: Didn't do enough for my acne
avis.texte: I am an avid user of pimple patches—I buy them weekly. I was excited to try this product and followed the instructions for application. The sheets were thin but forgiving. If I misplaced the sticker, I was able to reapply it to the correct place. After applying, I went to bed and allowed the stickers to sit on my skin overnight. When I woke up, I took the stickers off but did not notice much of a difference with my acne. The stickers themself were thin and could not absorb a lot of oil or imperfections. All in all, I wouldn't purchase this product because for the price and the one use application, it didn't do enough for my acne. Gifted by tonymoly

I am impressed by how fast this patches works! I tried it the first time and can see a noticeable improvement of pimples. Just follow the instructions of how to use it. Cleaned and dry my face then put the patches on and left it overnight. In the morning I can see the reductions of redness and inflammation. Amazing! Gifted by TONYMOLY

avis.titre: A bit expensive for a one-time use product but love it
avis.texte: I enjoyed using these as a person with oily-combination skin. My pores have been congested and feeling all clogged up because of the hot weather and also probably because I haven't exfoliated in awhile. These patches helped me to control my sebum and also extract some of the gunk out of my pores. It is so satisfying to see the strips when removing. The only thing is I wish it came with more patches. Gifted by tonymoly

I really like these patches! Great for when your skin is acting up or just when you want a relaxing self care night. Patches worked pretty well and pulled out gunk but be careful putting on sensitive areas since it might hurt coming off. Gifted by tiny moly
a super good product, I love how beautiful and clean my face is when removing this mask, it adapts very well to the face, reducing and eliminating impurities, I highly recommend it

This product has helped my skin so much. I suffer from cystic acne and my skin is always in a lot of pain. This product helped to drain oil from my skin and help to reduce the red appearance. I recommend this product to my friends and family. Gifted by tonymoly

Gifted by TONYMOLY This has to be the most effective thing I've tried for my time-of-the-month breakouts. I applied the patches overnight and after removing in the morning, cleansed as usual. This month I had no breakouts or acne scarring and my skin looks so clean!

avis.titre: Effective yet a bit difficult to use
avis.texte: I am a big fan of the whimsical yet effective products of TonyMoly. I enjoy their lighthearted approach to serious skin problems and their packaging is usually fun and eye-catching. The price point for their products is lower than many other similar brands on the market yet they seem to perform as well as brands that are more well-known in the US. I have had good results with this K beauty brand, and I particularly like their gel lightweight moisturizer and watery lotion made with green tea that are perfect for my oily complexion. I was very excited to try these charcoal face patches aimed at decreasing oil and clearing up acne. I have used many dots or patches in the past and have had varying results. I love the fact that these are made with charcoal, which is a Natural cleansing ingredient, and niacinamide that will help with the redness of blemishes. Unfortunately, these patches were extremely difficult to get off the backing and front to apply on my face. With only five patches, one for each target area, there was no room for error. I found that when I applied the nose patch particularly I was having to try and pry it away from the top surface for proper application and contour. in the advert, it shows an Asian woman with the patches nearly covering her entire face minus a few areas however I found that the forehead patch really just got to the T zone part of my forehead and the patches for the cheeks were more like large patch treatments that I would use on a cluster acn

Love these! I wore it right after cleansing and drying my face and went to bed. The patches stick well and it's not uncomfortable to sleep in it - because that was my fear, but nope, totally fine. Removed it in the morning and no sticky residue and no irritation. Showered and my skin felt super clean and my zits are definitely less noticeable and not t red or irritated. Definitely a life saver if you have an event the next day or anything like that. Will always keep these handy! Thankful to have received this complimentary from TONYMOLY.

Gifted by Tony Molly. This product is super cool! I love the idea of using overnight patches to help with acne and reduce oiliness of the skin. Very easy to use. Price point is ok too. I do recommend it.

Lately I have really been struggling with acne specifically on certain problem areas. I have been looking for a product that was easy and not a lot of work for my lazy stuff and I found this! They might not be glamorous looking—— but they work! Gifted by TONYMOLY

Game changer! I literally see all the impurities pulled out of my pores and I am left with clear pores and the softest skin! I love that these strips gifted by Tonymoly are gentle but effective. Super easy to use!

I tried these all over charcoal blemish patches gifted to me by TonyMoly and love them! They actually work really well and I saw a reduction in the number of blackheads and excess oil on my nose and chin!! They do leave marks on my face after pealing off but they go away quickly!

It is a great product overall … it does clean your skin of impurities preparing it for the day/night routine … easy to apply and works for all over your face, I would say is worth trying it It also helps with breakouts /acne etc Great value for the product Complimentary from Tonymoly

Gifted by Tony Moly. I liked these acne patches and they seemed to help treat my blemishes on my combination skin. I also like that it can cover my entire chin which is my area of concern. Deff recommend.

These are overall face charcoal infused patches for the face. This cover all the oily areas (T Zone) well and helps the acne prone skin to clear out the pores preventing more breakouts. Gifted by tony moly.

So I have REALLY stubborn acne. Like painful, obvious, bumpy acne. It's awful. Well I tried these patches on a whim. Now full disclosure, I didn't read the instructions (that's my bad) and was using them during a spa night with my daughter so we were snacking as I was wearing them (only then did I read the package to see how long they were meant to stay for, that's my bad). I noticed after I'd finished eating that the one on my chin was loose. I think this is my fault as I was moving it rather than putting it on before bed and going straight to sleep like the directions called for. I also messed up the placement on the nose so it was partially covering my nostrils and I couldn't stand the feeling all night so I did take it and the chin patch off early for these reasons. That being said, it was clear even though those patches were taken of 5-6 hours earlier than intended they were doing WORK. You could clearly see where my zits were on the patch from the guck left behind (for lack of better term). The forehead and cheek patches stayed on without issue the entire night. The cheek one is especially satisfying for me as I had an AWFUL zit right in my jaw so I made sure the patch covered it. This morning when I took off the patch not only was it nasty on the inside but my zit was flat and only a light pink mark left behind. Given how bad it was I consider this a win. I imagine a few nights of consistent use would clear it up entirely. I want to specifically note that the patches d

I was very disappointed, HOWEVER it did extract oil and blackheads from my nose and forehead so for that I give it some credit. to be honest its cheep and you get what you pay for, but for how it did I dont even think it should cost that much.
cheeks look less inflamed and flatter after wearing these over night. so far so good!

I've been breaking out on my chin area and gave this charcoal patch a try - I saw a clear difference in just one use, love that it has a large surface to cover larger areas. This will be my new go to for break outs!!

ok. pretty much love everything that has charcoal in it and this was not any different love these. I look a little ridiculous with them on but they definitely work! Made my zit feel smaller and flatter.

avis.titre: really like how it has niacinamide
